name: Ragdoll Engine ⚙️
desc:
A solo ragdoll experience where every hit is real. Dummies have organs and bones, and react to exactly where you hit them.

🎯 Hits hurt: they stagger, limp, faint and crawl
🦴 Falls break bones
⚡ Taser them, restart hearts, or raise a zombie
💥 Nukes, black holes and more. R revives everyone
